sentences.text: Let record of the Courts below be requisitioned.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent State of accepts notice on behalf of the State; as such, no further rt notice is required.
ou Heard on I.A. No.24731/2017, an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of petitioner C Baijnath.

h A perusal of the record reveals that the petitioner stands ig convicted under Sections 16 (1) (ka) (1)
read with section 7 H (1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for a period of 6 months and fine in the sum of Rs.1,000/- with default stipulation.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been jail since the date of the judgment of the Appellate Court i.e. 08.12.2017; therefore, it has been prayed that the jail sentence of the petitioner be suspended.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent State has opposed the application.

Keeping in view the facts and circumstances of the case in their entirety, particularly Baijnath vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 December, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95982336/
1 the quantum of sentence imposed upon the petitioner, in the opinion of this Court, the jail sh sentence of the petitioner deserves to be suspended.

Pr It is directed that on depositing the fine amount, if not a already deposited, and furnishing a personal bond in the sum hy of Rs.40,000/- with one solvent surety in the same amount to ad the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 19.07.2018 and

on all other M subsequent dates fixed by the Registry in this regard, the of remaining part of the substantive jail sentence imposed upon the petitioner shall stands suspended and he shall be released rt on bail.
